reason: I already have a cron job running claude -p, and the cloud agents we pay for do the scheduling for us. A pre-alpha tool from one developer at $99 a month does not beat that for my team.
objection: It is a solo-dev pre-alpha, and our vendors keep adding scheduling and background agents. Why would I add another moving part that could disappear?
would_change_my_mind: If my cron setup broke for a week of nights and I saw a demo where approval gates and retries saved real review time compared with plain cloud agents.
